resources.string: Keep at least one in your navigation. Hidden features stay available in Settings.
Optional. The usual schedule editor opens for each routine.
Create a task or review a timetable import. Nothing is created until you save it.
Start in Workspace → Queue. Four task notes walk you through a queue, a saved frame, a graph and a countdown. You can edit or remove the examples; none are scheduled.
Countdowns track calendar days without creating tasks or reminders.
